headline: Allstate (NYSE:ALL) Reports Bullish Q2 CY2026
summary: Insurance giant Allstate (NYSE:ALL) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.8% year on year to $18.6 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $8.99 per share was 48% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
